card.fires_on: Digits or decimal points inside phone numbers, years and formula constants, and partway through surnames in reference lists or contact lines. Fires on the marked piece, not on the full word.

modes.label: Constants in formulas

modes.label: Inside surnames
modes.description: A middle piece of a person's surname in an author or contact list.
